blocks.text: You can integrate AI Security with your Azure Blob Storage. This integration enables AI Security to send the issue data logs of your cloud resources to the Azure Blob Storage containers for storage and data analysis by external tools.
Only users with the administrator role can configure a cloud storage integration.
To configure the Azure Blob Storage integration:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > External Integrations.
On the Integrations page, click Add.
See image.
On the Add Integration page:
For Integration Name, enter a unique name.
For Cloud Storage, select Azure Blob Storage.
Click Next.
Under Cloud Storage, complete the following steps to provide AI Security with write permissions on Azure Blob Storage.
Copy the connection string from the Azure portal.
Log in to the Azure portal.
Go to your storage account.
Under Security > Networking, select Access Key.

Click Show Keys to view your access keys and connection strings. A connection string includes the authorization information required for AI Security to access data in your Azure Storage account. To learn more, refer to the Azure Blob Storage documentation.
Copy the entire connection string for the relevant access key.
For Azure Storage Account Connection String, paste the connection string you copied from the Azure portal.
(Optional) Container Location: Enter the location of the storage container. It is mandatory to first create a folder in your Azure Blob Storage and then add the name.
Click Test Connection to verify the connection between AI Security and the Azure Blob Storage. A message is displayed indicating the connection is verified.
Click Next.
Review the integration summary. Click the Edit icon if you want to make any changes.
See image.
Click Finish.

blocks.text: You can see the integration details on the Integrations page. The initial status is shown as Pending because data is not yet sent to the Azure Blob Storage. You must configure and associate the issue rules with this integration for AI Security to be able to send the data logs. When AI Security sends the data logs to the Blob Storage, then the status changes to Success.
